artifact.transcript:
AI: Thanks for calling Cavern Electrical. You've reached our after-hours line. I'm an automated assistant and this call is recorded so the team can follow up. What's going on tonight?
User: Our heat stopped working. We have electric baseboard heat and none of it is coming on.
AI: I'm sorry, that's no fun at night. Is the power on in the rest of the house?
User: Yes, lights work. But it's 6 degrees outside and it's already 58 in here, and we have a newborn.
AI: Understood, I'll mark this as a priority. Can I have your name and a callback number?
User: Tom Reyes, 612-555-0167.
AI: Thanks, Tom. And where are you located?
User: It's 77 Juniper Court, unit B.
AI: Thank you. I'm passing this to the on-call electrician now. In the meantime, keep doors closed and use safe, listed space heaters only if you have them.
User: Okay. Please hurry.
